query:
SELECT ct.id, ct.company_id,
                      (LOWER(BTRIM(ct.email)) = ce.email) IS TRUE AS "is_primary!"
               FROM crm_contact_emails ce
               JOIN crm_contacts ct ON ct.id = ce.contact_id
               WHERE ce.email = $2 AND ct.team_id = $1
               ORDER BY ct.id
               LIMIT 20
